node_hits.rationale: Walkthrough of the monthly close: sub-ledger close, manual accruals, trial balance, account reconciliations, dual-review control.

evidence.quote: Close starts on business day one. We run the sub-ledger close for AP and AR first, then post accruals manually in the GL.
accruals are fully manual today. The team builds them in spreadsheets and re-keys them. It's a real pain point
evidence.note: Manual accrual process; stated pain point; decentralized recon sign-off.

evidence.quote: we require a second-level reviewer to approve every reconciliation above fifty thousand dollars before the account is closed.

lens_signals.rationale: An active monthly close process exists.
Manual accruals are a recurring pain point and the main source of late adjustments.
Accruals are keyed by hand into the ERP from spreadsheets.
Established close activity, not new work.
Reconciliation sign-off is decentralized to regional controllers.

candidate_findings.observation: Accruals are built in spreadsheets and re-keyed into the ERP every close, driving late adjustments.
candidate_findings.recommended_action: Automate recurring accrual journals via an accrual engine / templated upload to cut re-keying and late adjustments.

candidate_findings.observation: Dual-review control over reconciliations above $50k is attested verbally but not written into any policy or system config.
candidate_findings.recommended_action: Validate the dual-review control against a policy/system source; document it or open a control gap.
